outcome: SARS-CoV-2 antibodies in umbilical cord blood
cohort: 28 pregnant women in Denmark with confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection who gave birth between August 2020 and March 2021.
finding: SARS-CoV-2 was detected in only 2 of 28 vaginal swabs within 8 days of confirmed infection; maternal seroconversion typically occurred between 8-16 days post-infection, and umbilical cord blood antibodies in seropositive mothers were present in the majority from 26 days after confirmed infection.
